summary: Renamed billingUrl->billingEndpoint (same value) in libs/shared-contracts and all users (core-shell, sub-route-billing, and sub-route-reports, which also read it) in one PR #1; CI and CD green. Assumptions: shared-contracts lives in the monorepo and is inlined at build time, so no version bump or dependency adoption applies (sub-tasks 2/3 'adopt new release' are N/A; one atomic PR needed). libs-platform-kit has no reference to billingUrl and does not depend on shared-contracts, so PLAT-102-4 needed no change; no PR or release made there.
